title: Babban Mai Haɓaka Manhajojin Tsarin Windows
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Aikin

Wanda aka zaɓa zai ɗauki nauyin waɗannan ayyuka:

  • Tsarawa, haɓakawa da inganta muhimman sassan tsarin Windows na ƙasan matakai don Kyber
  • Haɓaka manhajojin sabis na Windows, wakilan tsarin da manhajojin tuƙa na'urori (a yanayin mai amfani da kuma yanayin tushen tsarin, gwargwadon buƙata)
  • Yin aiki kai tsaye da API na asali na Windows (Win32, NT Native API) tare da mu'amala da sauran tsarin Windows (Active Directory/Kerberos, da sauransu)
  • Bincike da warware matsaloli masu sarƙaƙiya da suka shafi saurin aiki, sarrafa ƙwaƙwalwa, daidaita gudanar ayyuka a lokaci ɗaya, da tsaro
  • Gudanar da zurfafaffen aikin gano da gyara kurakurai (nazarin bayanan rugujewar shiri, binciken kurakurai a tushen tsarin, nazarin tarin kiran ayyuka, da kuma warware tsarin manhaja zuwa tushenta a wasu lokuta)
  • Rubuta takardun bayanan fasaha masu sauƙin fahimta kuma masu ɗorewa
  • Shiga cikin yanke shawarwari kan tsarin gine-ginen ƙasan matakai da kuma muhimman bitar lambobin shirye-shirye
  • Ci gaba da bibiyar sabbin abubuwa a kan tsarin cikin Windows da kayan aikin tsarin.

Ƙwarewar Fasaha da Ake Buƙata

  • Zurfin sani game da tsarin cikin Windows da dukkan abubuwan da suka danganci shi
  • Ƙwaƙƙwarar fahimtar dabarun daidaita gudanar ayyuka a lokaci ɗaya, sarrafa ƙwaƙwalwa da sarrafa kurakurai a matakin tsarin, tare da fahimtar bambanci tsakanin yanayin mai amfani da yanayin tushen tsarin, da kuma sarrafa zaman masu amfani
  • Ƙwarewa ta zahiri wajen amfani da kayan aikin gano kurakurai da nazari na Windows
  • Harsunan shirye-shirye: C / C++ / Rust / x86/x64
  • Kayan aiki da muhalli: Visual Studio da kayan aikin haɗa shirye-shirye na Windows, GitLab da hanyoyin haɓaka manhaja tare a matsayin ƙungiya

Game da Kai

  • Shekaru 5 zuwa 10 na gogewa a fannin haɓaka manhaja, musamman a kan rubuta shirye-shiryen tsarin Windows
  • Tabbataccen tarihin aiki a kan tsare-tsare masu sarƙaƙiya da muhimmanci
  • Ƙwaƙƙwaran tunani a ƙasan matakai da iya fahimtar manyan rumbunan lambobin shirye-shirye da ke nan tun tuni
  • Tsantseni, iya aiki da kai, da kula da ƙananan bayanai, tare da sha'awar warware matsalolin fasaha masu wuyar gaske
  • Iya raba ilimi da kuma jagorantar sabbin injiniyoyi

Ƙwarewar da Za Ta Ƙara Maka Daraja:

  • Gogewa a fannin tsaron tsarin ko ƙarfafa tsaron sassan Windows, sanin warware tsarin manhaja zuwa tushenta ko nazarin manhajoji masu cutarwa, da gudummawa ga ayyukan buɗaɗɗen tushe na ƙasan matakai ko na tsarin
  • Gogewa a muhallai masu tsauraran sharuɗɗa (tsare-tsaren da ke aiki nan take, tsare-tsaren da dole su kasance a kunne a kowane lokaci, manhajojin da tsaro ke da matuƙar muhimmanci a cikinsu)

Matakan Tattaunawar Ɗaukar Aiki

  1. Kiran Tantancewa na Minti 15: Ɗan taƙaitaccen hira game da abin da ke ƙarfafa maka gwiwa, dacewarka da aikin, da amsa tambayoyinka da ba na fasaha ba.
  2. Tattaunawar Fasaha da Kayayyaki ta Awa 1, Sau Biyu: Zurfafa bincike kan yadda kake tunkarar warware matsaloli, tare da CTO ɗinmu da/ko babban masanin tsara mafita na kamfaninmu
  3. Ganawa da Ƙungiya: Zama na sakin jiki don tabbatar da cewa za ka dace da al'adunmu.

Abin da Muke Bayarwa

  • Ayyuka masu zurfin fasaha da ke ƙalubalantar tunani
  • Muhallin da ke daraja ƙwarewar injiniya ta gaskiya kuma ya mai da hankali kan fasaha (babu tarukan banza ko rubuce-rubucen rahotanni marasa amfani)
  • Cikakken 'yanci wajen yanke shawarwarin fasaha
